Questions.question: Why did the safety inspector ask about the accident?
Questions.answer: To accurately document the incident and submit an accident report.
options: To find out who was responsible for the accident and submit a report.
To accurately document the incident and submit an accident report.
To check if the workshop was overcrowded.

Questions.question: What detail strongly suggests that the accident could have been prevented?
Questions.answer: The absence of cut-resistant gloves during machine operation.
options: The absence of two instructors in the room to supervise.
The absence of cut-resistant gloves during machine operation.
The use of a hand held grinder.

Questions.question: Which factor directly contributed to the trainee losing control while working?
options: The size of the concrete blocks

Questions.question: What was the immediate response of the instructor that prevented further injury?
options: Clearing the room of the other trainees

Questions.question: What does the trainee’s final response show about his attitude after the accident?
Questions.answer: He understands the importance of personal responsibility and safety compliance.
options: He believes accidents are unavoidable in workplaces.
He expects stricter supervision from instructors.
He understands the importance of personal responsibility and safety compliance.

activity_b.text: Good morning.
I’m the safety inspector for the Construction industry division.
Thank you for coming in.
I need to ask you a few questions in order to complete the accident report.
Is that okay?
Good morning, sir.
Yes, that’s fine.
First of all, could you please tell me your full name?
My name is Dilshan Perera.
Thank you, Dilshan.
I understand there was an accident here yesterday at around 9 a.m.
When exactly did the accident take place?
The accident happened yesterday at 10.25 a.m., during the morning practical session.
And where exactly did it happen?
It happened at the construction training site, near the mortar laying area.
Who else was present at that time?
Our instructor and two other trainees were in the room.
They were working nearby, setting out the wall line.
What task did you carry out just before the accident?
I used the hand angle grinder to cut concrete blocks.
Please describe how the accident happened.
The grinder had been cleaned with a damp cloth.
When I adjusted my grip, the grinder slipped and cut my hand near the thumb.
Were you wearing all the required safety equipment?
I wore a safety helmet and safety shoes, but I forgot to wear the cut-resistant protection gloves.
Now I know that it wasn’t safe.
Thank you for being honest.
What did you do immediately after the injury?
I called the instructor.
He stopped the machine immediately, applied pressure to stop the bleeding and informed the site supervisor.
Did you receive any further medical attention after that?
Yes, sir.
I went to a nearby clinic.
The doctor examined the injury, stitched the wound and gave me a tetanus injection.
Finally, what can you do to help prevent this type of accident in the future?
We should always wear all personal protection equipment, keep work surfaces dry and follow safety instructions carefully.
That sounds sensible.
Thank you for your cooperation.
I have all the information I need to complete the report.
